recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，一條粗骨小樑內有兩個被蝕骨細胞整圈包圍的圓形吸收腔（Howship's lacunae），骨小樑邊緣有淡粉紅、疏鬆的旁小樑纖維組織，周圍骨髓仍有脂肪與造血細胞，是腎性骨病變／副甲狀腺亢進的低倍特徵。
features: Low-power H&E trephine with several thick, irregular bony trabeculae
Two intratrabecular resorption cavities lined circumferentially by multinucleated osteoclasts
Resorption cavities filled with pale loose fibrous stroma
Paratrabecular bands of loose fibrous tissue with spindle cells separating bone from hematopoietic marrow
Intervening marrow shows fat spaces and trilineage hematopoietic cells
Focal basophilic smudge within a trabecula, likely cement line/decalcification artifact
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of the bone marrow trephine shows thickened, irregular bony trabeculae containing two intratrabecular resorption cavities lined by numerous multinucleated osteoclasts and filled with loose fibrous tissue. Paratrabecular fibrosis with spindle cells is present along trabecular surfaces, while the intervening marrow retains fat and hematopoietic elements. These features reflect increased osteoclastic bone resorption with peritrabecular fibrosis. In the setting of chronic renal failure and hypocalcemia, findings are consistent with renal osteodystrophy with secondary hyperparathyroidism.

ddx.vs: Bone changes are identical and are separated by biochemistry (hypercalcemia in primary disease versus hypocalcemia and renal failure in secondary).
PMF shows diffuse marrow fibrosis with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and osteosclerosis rather than osteoclast-rich resorption cavities with paratrabecular fibrosis.
Paget disease has a mosaic pattern of cement lines and very large osteoclasts with many nuclei, with fibrovascular marrow, rather than tunnelling resorption.
Mastocytosis produces paratrabecular fibrotic lesions composed of spindled CD117/tryptase-positive mast cells, often with eosinophils, rather than osteoclast-lined cavities.
